title: Cold rebuild: Load several pages
summary: Rebuild Load several pages from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Load several pages** in *fetch and HTTP*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: A request returns status 404. What does `await fetch(url)` do?
options: Fulfils with a Response whose `ok` is false and `status` is 404
steps.explain: Unlike `HttpClient.GetFromJsonAsync`, `fetch` treats any HTTP answer as a success. You must check `res.ok` yourself.
